business_rules: Evaluation must include Job title, Job description text, and Location/region metadata.
Scores are aggregated from 22 specific features.
Scoring covers four categories: Clarity of Posting, Inclusive Culture, Exclusive Practices, and Language.
features.description: Analyzes job description text using ML models to calculate a composite inclusivity score based on 22 signals.
features.name: Job Description Inclusivity Scoring
Improvement Recommendation Generation
features.description: Generates actionable suggestions and recommendations to improve the inclusivity and clarity of job descriptions based on the scoring analysis.

features.name: Score Recalculation
features.description: Allows recruiters to trigger a new scoring cycle after updating job description text to verify improvements.

constraints: External system dependency on Workday Recruiting.
business_rules: Workday remains the System of Record for all job requisition data.
Workday triggers the evaluation and consumes/displays the results.
features.name: Workday Recruiting Integration
features.description: Integration with Workday Recruiting to trigger inclusivity reviews during the job requisition lifecycle and display results within the Workday UI.

features.name: Scoring Persistence and Audit Logging
business_rules: No candidate PII (Personally Identifiable Information) may be processed or stored.
features.description: Persists inclusivity scores, feature-level results, historical changes, and recommendation acceptance status for audit and trend analysis.
Exposes secure REST endpoints via AWS API Gateway for initial score calculation and subsequent recalculations.
features.name: Secure Scoring API
Automated Scaling and Performance
features.description: The system automatically scales compute resources to handle fluctuations in hiring volume while maintaining performance targets.
The tool is designed to evaluate job descriptions written in English for English-speaking regions.
features.name: English Language Localization
